tier1_schedule_disruptions.title: 10:00 AM Late Start Wednesday
tier1_schedule_disruptions.description: District-wide teacher professional learning morning. Morning rural bus routes pick up exactly 2 hours after standard morning schedule. No morning preschool. Breakfast service runs prior to the 10:00 AM bell.

tier1_schedule_disruptions.title: PRHS Testing Window: Pre-ACT & WorkKeys
tier1_schedule_disruptions.description: State-mandated assessment testing window for high school students. Pre-ACT administered Wednesday, Oct 21; ACT WorkKeys vocational readiness exam administered Thursday, Oct 22.

tier1_schedule_disruptions.title: No School — Veterans Day Observance
tier1_schedule_disruptions.description: All USD 449 buildings and classrooms closed in honor of Veterans Day. Community Veterans Day parade in Easton.

tier1_schedule_disruptions.title: No School — Thanksgiving Holiday Break
tier1_schedule_disruptions.description: District offices and campuses closed for Thanksgiving holiday. Classes resume regular schedule Monday, November 30.

tier2_gear_deadlines_action.title: PRES 1st Grade Autumn Field Trip: Fun Farm
tier2_gear_deadlines_action.description: Pleasant Ridge 1st graders visit Fun Farm pumpkin patch. Signed parent permission slips and mud/outdoor boots required.

tier2_gear_deadlines_action.title: PRHS & PRMS Portrait Retake Day
tier2_gear_deadlines_action.description: Portrait retakes for middle and high school students who missed orientation or need re-shoots. Return original photo packets.

tier2_gear_deadlines_action.title: PRES Elementary Picture Retake Day
tier2_gear_deadlines_action.description: Elementary photo retakes. Return original proof envelopes to homeroom teachers.

tier2_gear_deadlines_action.title: USD 449 Rural Transportation Route Verification
tier2_gear_deadlines_action.description: For student safety across rural routes, afternoon bus pass requests or pickup location changes require notice to the transportation office before 1:30 PM daily.

tier3_marquee_gatherings.title: PRHS Varsity Football vs. Maur Hill-Mount Academy (Senior Night)
tier3_marquee_gatherings.description: Senior Night showcase! Senior athletes, cheerleaders, band members, and cross-country runners honored on field at 6:30 PM prior to kickoff vs Maur Hill.

tier3_marquee_gatherings.title: PRHS PTO Haunted Hallways & Community Trunk-or-Treat
tier3_marquee_gatherings.description: District-wide autumn tradition! Walkthrough haunted hallways and parking lot trunk-or-treat hosted by PRHS PTO. Concessions open.

tier3_marquee_gatherings.title: PRMS Girls Basketball @ Everest
tier3_marquee_gatherings.description: Middle school girls basketball road clash against Everest.

tier3_marquee_gatherings.title: PRES Halloween Costume Parade & Classroom Parties
tier3_marquee_gatherings.description: Annual PRES Halloween costume parade followed by PTO-assisted classroom parties. Elementary families welcome to observe parade.
